High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 715 of 2023
Applicant :- Vishal Vishwakarma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy.Home Deptt. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vikas Chandra Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Heard Shri Vikas Chandra Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Vishal Vishwakarma in Case Crime/ F.I.R. No. 250 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 IPC, Police Station Dostpur, District Sultanpur, with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.

The applicant is posted in Bandhan Bank, Akbarpur, District Ambedkar Nagar as cashier and has joined in the aforesaid Branch on 13.6.2022 and the First Information Report pertaining to the instant case has been lodged on 22.9.2022.

It is vehemently submitted that there is no evidence pertaining to misappropriation of money by the applicant and the Branch Manager of the concerned Branch in order to save his skin has falsely involved the applicant in connivance with the Area Manager of the Bank who is shown to have Vishal Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is vehemently submitted that the applicant is a respectable citizen and there is no apprehension that he may flee from the course of law and in case any protection is granted to him he will also cooperate in the investigation and thus, protection from arrest be granted to him as he is not having any criminal history.

Learned AGA on the other hand submits that the applicant is accused of misappropriating Rs.
10,98,000/- pertaining to 32 customers of the bank and keeping in view the fiduciary relationships which the customers of the bank are having with the bank the applicant is not entitled for any relief as he is accused of breaking the same.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the allegations against the applicant are to the tune that he at the relevant point of time was posted as a cashier of the bank and on 16.8.2022 the Area Manager of Bandhan Bank had inspected the branch and it is in this inspection it emerges that the instant applicant has misappropriated the money to the tune of Rs. 10,98,000/- pertaining to 32 customers.
The allegations against the applicant are grave.
The relationship of the customers with the bank is of the trust and confidence and by the happening of such incident the trust of the customers is shaken in the banking system.

Thus having regard to the larger interest of the society and to ensure the trust and confidence which general public is having in the banking system, in the considered opinion of this Court the applicant is not entitled to get any discretion and thus the Anticipatory Bail Application moved by the applicant is hereby rejected.

However, mere rejection of the anticipatory bail application moved on behalf of the applicant would not preclude him for moving a regular bail application before the appropriate Court and if such an application is moved immediately, the same may be disposed of with utmost expedition by the trial court, after providing an opportunity of being heard to the parties, strictly in accordance with law.
Order Date :- 23.3.2023
